# NetworkDiameterMetric

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The maximum shortest-path distance between any two nodes in the graph, denoted δ(G), representing the worst-case hop count. Bounds the maximum communication latency in the physical topology, essential for meeting real-time inference deadlines.
